resources.string: Keep processing or request a safe stop?

The video is still being processed or verified. You can continue, or request a safe stop and stay here while the result is checked. If final publication has already been admitted, stopping may be too late. The original is kept.
Publication is in progress. Stay here to check the actual result and status. This does not mean the video has finished or that a stop request has been accepted. The original is kept.
Safe stop requested. Waiting for processing and media resources to exit. Stay here to check the result; the original is kept.
Final publication has already been admitted, so stopping cannot be confirmed. Checking the actual publication result; the original is kept.
Stop was requested, but processing or file resources have not yet confirmed exit. Files are kept and a new edit cannot start. Continue waiting, or fully exit and reopen the app for recovery checks.
